scenario_description:
Objective: Preserve the next-morning Oakland intake reached by an early PDX flight with a rigid hand-carry loan case.
Emerging Need: The paid MAX approach is ordinary until an evening Red Line airport-bus substitution creates a plausible lateness risk for the case transfer.
Decision Context: The useful timing depends on stored disruption notes and the profile pickup label that identify when a pre-dawn hard-case cab hold is warranted.
Consequence: After the advance-dispatch board closes, travel can still proceed, but reliable vehicle assignment for the case is no longer protectable.

parameter.title: Oakland Museum hand-carry frame intake
parameter.description: Secure receiving intake after the morning PDX-to-OAK flight; rigid hand-carry loan case stays with courier throughout passenger travel.

parameter.body: Confirmation F9Q4L: AS 341 departs PDX at 07:10 and arrives OAK at 08:55 on Aug 22. Boarding closes at 06:55. Passenger may keep one rigid hand-carry case at the gate subject to ordinary screening.

parameter.content: Service alert for Sat Aug 22, 04:15-06:45: Red Line trains terminate at Gateway Transit Center. Shuttle buses will serve stations between Gateway and PDX Airport; allow extra time for station-to-terminal transfers.

parameter.subject: Saturday pre-06:00 PDX advance-dispatch board closed
parameter.body: The advance-dispatch board for Saturday pre-06:00 PDX airport pickups closed at 21:00. Unbooked riders may still call day-of when ready, but dispatch cannot hold a vehicle type or confirm extra hard-case space tonight.
